blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Thirteen years after Super Typhoon Yolanda (international name: Haiyan) wreaked havoc in parts of Visayas, the Diocese of Borongan has called on the faithful to reject destructive mining, emphasizing that remembering the tragedy is not enough. In its message on Sunday, the Diocese of Borongan remembered the tragic incident that killed people, damaged communities, and left scars among families. It then thanked the Lord and the people who extended their generosity for the victims to rebuild their lives. “But remembering is not enough.
